body:
During an isothermal expansion of an ideal gas, its internal-energy change is

Choices:
A. positive
B. negative
C. zero
D. equal to pressure

Which of the following best explains why energy is spontaneously transferred from a hot object to a cold object?

Choices:
A. The transfer decreases the total entropy of the system
B. The transfer increases the total entropy of the system
C. The transfer violates conservation of energy
D. The transfer decreases the entropy of the cold object

The electric field direction at a point is the direction of force on

Choices:
A. a positive test charge
B. a negative test charge
C. any neutral object
D. an electron only

Moving a positive charge opposite a uniform electric field causes electric potential energy to

Choices:
A. decrease
B. increase
C. remain zero
D. become negative regardless of the starting value

Two identical positive point charges are placed on a horizontal line, one to the left of the other. At the midpoint between them, the electric field is

Choices:
A. zero
B. toward the left charge
C. toward the right charge
D. infinite

Immediately after an uncharged capacitor is connected through a resistor to a battery, the capacitor behaves approximately like

Choices:
A. an open circuit
B. a wire
C. a charged battery
D. a resistor with the same resistance as the series resistor

At a point where electric potential is zero, the electric field

Choices:
A. must be zero
B. must be constant nearby
C. may be nonzero
D. must point toward that point

An electron accelerated from rest through a potential difference of magnitude ΔV gains kinetic energy equal to

Choices:
A. eΔV
B. (1/2)eΔV
C. 2eΔV
D. -eΔV

A capacitor in series with a resistor has been connected to a DC battery for a very long time. The circuit current is

Choices:
A. battery voltage divided by R
B. zero
C. infinite
D. set only by C
